items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would like to recall this incident that happened while we were at Billy Berg's Swing Club.

ctx.x: They opened there in 1946, so they were still keeping the flag flying.

How about that. I’ll tell you, I would like to recall this incident that happened while we were at Billy Berg's Swing Club. We heard about a place where a trio was playing that was a mind-blowing experience, to go hear this trio.
I know who you're talking about, yeah.
